title: English Conversation 3:  Gossip
content: 1. What's going on?: What's happening? - It is very noisy in that room. What's going on? - There are many police cars outside. What's going on? 2. to get a divorce: to legally end a marriage - Mark and Sally got a divorce. - She wants to get a divorce, but her husband doesn't want to. 3. to cheat on someone: to secretly be in a romantic relationship with a person who is not one's husband, wife, boyfriend, or girlfriend - Tina and Mark got divorced because Tina was cheating on Mark. - He cheats on his girlfriend a lot when he travels on business.
